[Verse 1]
[tab]                           [ch]C[/ch]
Hurry over and cry, Lafayette[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]           [ch]G[/ch]                [ch]Am[/ch]        [ch]G[/ch]
I knew that I'd lose you the moment we met[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]C[/ch]           [ch]Am[/ch]          [ch]F[/ch]           [ch]G[/ch]
But the bayou still sings every night in my head[/tab]
[tab]         [ch]C[/ch]          [ch]G[/ch]             [ch]C[/ch]
Though I can't understand what it wants[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]            [ch]G[/ch]             [ch]Am[/ch]           [ch]G[/ch]
I love when it rains but I hate getting wet[/tab]
[tab]      [ch]C[/ch]               [ch]G[/ch]             [ch]C[/ch]
Never thought it'd be me that you'd haunt[/tab]

[Verse 2]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]
Can't remember your words, Lafayette[/tab]
[tab]           [ch]F[/ch]            [ch]G[/ch]            [ch]Am[/ch]             [ch]G[/ch]
You said, "Words didn't matter, it's what's in your head"[/tab]
[tab]    [ch]C[/ch]            [ch]Am[/ch]              [ch]F[/ch]            [ch]G[/ch]
But if you don't ask then you're bound not to get[/tab]
[tab]      [ch]C[/ch]             [ch]G[/ch]            [ch]C[/ch]
Still know what you said wasn't wrong[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]              [ch]G[/ch]         [ch]Am[/ch]            [ch]G[/ch]
I can't turn a corner or walk down the street[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]C[/ch]           [ch]G[/ch]         [ch]C[/ch]    N.C.
Without seeing your face come along[/tab]

[Chorus]
[tab]          [ch]Am[/ch] [ch]Em[/ch]               [ch]Am[/ch] [ch]Em[/ch]
Last born son, yeah, loaded gun[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]        [ch]G[/ch]           [ch]C[/ch]      [ch]Am[/ch]             [ch]G[/ch]               [ch]F[/ch]
You know I recall somebody saying, "Therе ain't no cowboys left"[/tab]
[tab]    [ch]G[/ch]                     N.C.                    [ch]C[/ch]    [ch]Am[/ch]  [ch]F[/ch]  [ch]G[/ch]
But they ain't met mе and they ain't met you, Lafayette[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]            [ch]Am[/ch]          [ch]F[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]
 They ain't met me, Lafayette[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch] [ch]Am[/ch] [ch]F[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]F[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]
Oooooooooh[/tab]
[tab]N.C.                     [ch]C[/ch]
They ain't met you, Lafayette[/tab]

[Verse 3]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]
The months march away, Lafayette[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]          [ch]G[/ch]                  [ch]Am[/ch]         [ch]G[/ch]
I hear it takes years for the heart to reset[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]C[/ch]            [ch]Am[/ch]            [ch]F[/ch]           [ch]G[/ch]
Yeah, but one of these days, I'll be done with regret[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]C[/ch]              [ch]G[/ch]            [ch]C[/ch]
